subject: AcmeTech: BYOK rotation snapshots + HSM operator sampling & canary rotation drill
messages:
From: Samuel Park <samuel.park@acmetech.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: audit@acmetech.com
Date: 2028-07-05T09:23:00Z
Subject: BYOK rotation evidence, HSM operator logs and a canary rotation request

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick intro on Friday. AcmeTech is starting our SOC 2 topical deep-dive on key management and we need a compact evidence bundle to close a few open items. Could you please provide the following by EOD next Wednesday if possible: 

- Rotation snapshots (wrap/unwrap events) for the last 18 months, CSV export with timestamps, operator id and wrapping key IDs.
- HSM operator access logs and shift handover notes for any key ceremonies affecting tenant BYOK in that window.
- KMS audit trail (API-level calls) covering Encrypt/Decrypt/Generate/Import/Export events – 90-day raw logs plus a longer-term index.
- Confirmation of at-rest encryption keys and envelope keys used for S3 and DB replication (high level: algorithms, key lengths, KMS alias mapping).
- Evidence of split-keystore/sealed ceremony (attestation or minutes), and any periodic rewrap/rotation policies.

Two additional asks: 
1) We want to run a short canary rotation to observe rekey behavior in our tenant. Would Redwood be able to coordinate a 10–15 minute test window next Tuesday (2028-07-12) between 16:00–18:00 UTC? We will be on standby; we just need logs and confirmation that there was no data loss or service degradation.
2) Please redact any operator-only PII before delivery. We will accept hashed operator ids and a mapping file for our auditors.

Attached is the SOC2 questionnaire section that our auditors will reference.

Appreciate the help — let me know what you need from our side to schedule the canary.

Best,
Samuel
Samuel Park
Senior Security Engineer, AcmeTech
Attachment: SOC2-questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samuel Park <samuel.park@acmetech.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-05T12:11:00Z
Subject: Re: BYOK rotation evidence, HSM operator logs and a canary rotation request

Hi Samuel — thanks, we can take this on. High-level plan and constraints below so auditors know what to expect.

Plan (deliverables and timing):
- Rotation snapshots CSV: we will produce a compressed export (wrap_events_2016-2028.csv.gz) with event_ts, tenant_id, wrapping_key_id, operator_hash, event_type. Expect initial export in 3 business days.
- HSM operator logs & ceremony minutes: we will pull shiftlog excerpts and ceremony minutes; operator identifiers will be hashed (sha256) per your request. Delivery in 4 business days after redaction.
- KMS API audit trail: we will provide two artifacts — a 90-day raw log bundle and an index summary (counts by event). Index available in 3 days, raw logs in 5 days (compressed).
- At-rest/envelope key summary: one-page matrix (algorithm/key length/alias). 2 business days.
- Split-keystore attestation: we can provide the ceremony minutes and the internal attestation statement for the last formal ceremony (redacted). 5 business days.

Canary rotation request: we can run a canary rewrap for your tenant, but we need: 
- A signed operational SLA exception (we will provide a short Doc) and an agreed maintenance window with Redwood on-call listed.
- A rollback/abort condition list (we will run the rotation against a sample key with automatic fallback and a TTL).

Proposed safe window: 2028-07-12 16:30–16:45 UTC (15 minutes). During the test we will stream an event summary to a pre-signed S3 link; full logs will follow once redacted. Please confirm acceptance of the 15-minute window and if you need us to change the time.

Security notes: We will redact PII, hash operator ids, and provide signed checksums for any exported bundles. We will not export HSM master material under any circumstance.

If that plan looks good I will loop in Jonas (runtime lead) for the log extraction and Ben (security ops) for the attestation artifacts.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Security Compliance, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
Attachment: rotation-checklist.md (md)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Samuel Park <samuel.park@acmetech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-05T15:42:00Z
Subject: Re: BYOK rotation evidence, HSM operator logs and a canary rotation request

Thanks — quick operational notes from the runtime side: 

- Log locations: raw audit bundles will be exported from our internal logging S3: s3://redwood-evidence/acmetech/rotation-snapshots/2026-2028/ (we will provide a pre-signed download link).
- Format: wrap_events CSV (ts,tenant,wrap_key_id,event,operator_hash,request_id), KMS API NDJSON for event correlation.
- Redaction: operator names -> sha256(operator_email + salt). We'll provide the salt in a separate access-controlled file for the auditors.
- Sampling: HSM shiftlogs are stored as encrypted artifacts. We'll produce sampling excerpts (2x per quarter) and the ceremony minutes for any tenant-impacting event. 
- Canary runbook (short):
  1) Select sample wrapping key (non-primary).
  2) Snapshot KV cache and create read-only shadow keys.
  3) Issue rewrap for a small object set (10 items). Verify decrypts.
  4) Abort/rollback if >0.5% error rate or latency spike >250ms P50 beyond baseline.

I will create the pre-signed links and a temporary role for AcmeTech auditors to fetch the redacted bundles. HubSpot ticket HS-4821 will track progress.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Principal Runtime Engineer, Redwood Inference

Irene/Jonas —

Thanks for the clear plan. We accept the proposed 15-minute window on 2028-07-12 16:30–16:45 UTC. Please proceed with the pre-signed S3 link approach for retrieval and the hashed operator ids — auditors prefer the salt be shared in a separate secure channel, so that works.

Two small clarifications before you start extraction work: 
- Can you confirm that ephemeral keys used for streaming (if any) will not be included in the exported wrap_events CSV (we only need tenant wrapping events)?
- Please include the request_id correlation header for every event so we can map to our ingress traces.

We will sign the operational SLA exception and upload to the HubSpot ticket HS-4821 today. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Samuel
Samuel Park
Senior Security Engineer, AcmeTech
